- (oracle)  Additionally it lets you edit most properties in the local composer.json.
- (oracle)  
- (oracle)  To set a config setting:
- (oracle)  
- (oracle)      <comment><PHP_SELF> config bin-dir bin/</comment>
- (oracle)  
- (oracle)  To read a config setting:
- (oracle)  
- (oracle)      <comment><PHP_SELF> config bin-dir</comment>
- (oracle)      Outputs: <info>bin</info>
- (oracle)  
- (oracle)  To edit the global config.json file:
- (oracle)  
- (oracle)      <comment><PHP_SELF> config --global</comment>
- (oracle)  
- (oracle)  To add a repository:
- (oracle)  
- (oracle)      <comment><PHP_SELF> config repositories.foo vcs https://bar.com</comment>
- (oracle)  
- (oracle)  To remove a repository (repo is a short alias for repositories):
- (oracle)  
- (oracle)      <comment><PHP_SELF> config --unset repo.foo</comment>
- (oracle)  
- (oracle)  To disable packagist.org:
- (oracle)  
- (oracle)      <comment><PHP_SELF> config repo.packagist.org false</comment>
- (oracle)  
- (oracle)  You can alter repositories in the global config.json file by passing in the
- (oracle)  <info>--global</info> option.
- (oracle)  
- (oracle)  To add or edit suggested packages you can use:
- (oracle)  
- (oracle)      <comment><PHP_SELF> config suggest.package reason for the suggestion</comment>
- (oracle)  
- (oracle)  To add or edit extra properties you can use:
- (oracle)  
- (oracle)      <comment><PHP_SELF> config extra.property value</comment>
- (oracle)  
- (oracle)  Or to add a complex value you can use json with:
- (oracle)  
- (oracle)      <comment><PHP_SELF> config extra.property --json '{"foo":true, "bar": []}'</comment>
- (oracle)  
- (oracle)  To edit the file in an external editor:
- (oracle)  
- (oracle)      <comment><PHP_SELF> config --editor</comment>
- (oracle)  
- (oracle)  To choose your editor you can set the "EDITOR" env variable.
- (oracle)  
- (oracle)  To get a list of configuration values in the file:

+ (go) Description:
+ (go)   Installs the project dependencies from the composer.lock file if present, or falls back on the composer.json
+ (go) 
+ (go) Usage:
+ (go)   install [options] [--] [<packages>...]
+ (go)   i
+ (go) 
+ (go) Arguments:
+ (go)   packages                     Should not be provided, use composer require instead to add a given package to composer.json.
+ (go) 
+ (go) Options:
+ (go)       --prefer-source          Forces installation from package sources when possible, including VCS information.
+ (go)       --prefer-dist            Forces installation from package dist (default behavior).
+ (go)       --prefer-install=PREFER-INSTALL Forces installation from package dist|source|auto (auto chooses source for dev versions, dist for the rest).
+ (go)       --dry-run                Outputs the operations but will not execute anything (implicitly enables --verbose).
+ (go)       --download-only          Download only, do not install packages.
+ (go)       --dev                    DEPRECATED: Enables installation of require-dev packages (enabled by default, only present for BC).
+ (go)       --no-suggest             DEPRECATED: This flag does not exist anymore.
+ (go)       --no-dev                 Disables installation of require-dev packages.
+ (go)       --no-security-blocking   DEPRECATED: use --no-blocking instead. Allows installing packages with security advisories, that are abandoned or that are still in the cooldown period (can also be set via the COMPOSER_NO_SECURITY_BLOCKING=1 env var).
+ (go)       --no-blocking            Disables all policy blocking during this command, including the cooldown period (can also be set via the COMPOSER_NO_BLOCKING=1 env var).
+ (go)       --no-autoloader          Skips autoloader generation
+ (go)       --no-progress            Do not output download progress.
+ (go)       --no-install             Do not use, only defined here to catch misuse of the install command.
+ (go)       --audit                  Run an audit after installation is complete.
+ (go)       --audit-format=AUDIT-FORMAT Audit output format. Must be "table", "plain", "json", or "summary".
+ (go)   -v|-vv|-vvv, --verbose       Shows more details including new commits pulled in when updating packages.
+ (go)   -o, --optimize-autoloader    Optimize autoloader during autoloader dump
+ (go)   -a, --classmap-authoritative Autoload classes from the classmap only. Implicitly enables `--optimize-autoloader`.
+ (go)       --strict-psr-autoloader  Return a failed status code (6) if PSR-4 or PSR-0 mapping errors are present. Requires --optimize-autoloader or --classmap-authoritative to work.
+ (go)       --apcu-autoloader        Use APCu to cache found/not-found classes.
+ (go)       --apcu-autoloader-prefix=APCU-AUTOLOADER-PREFIX Use a custom prefix for the APCu autoloader cache. Implicitly enables --apcu-autoloader
+ (go)       --ignore-platform-req=IGNORE-PLATFORM-REQ Ignore a specific platform requirement (php & ext- packages).
+ (go)       --ignore-platform-reqs   Ignore all platform requirements (php & ext- packages).
+ (go)   -h, --help                   Display help for the given command. When no command is given display help for the list command
+ (go)   -q, --quiet                  Do not output any message
+ (go)   -v|-vv|-vvv, --verbose       Increase the verbosity of messages: 1 for normal output, 2 for more verbose output and 3 for debug
+ (go)   -V, --version                Display this application version
+ (go)       --ansi                   Force (or disable --no-ansi) ANSI output
+ (go)   -n, --no-interaction         Do not ask any interactive question
+ (go)       --profile                Display timing and memory usage information
+ (go)       --no-plugins             Whether to disable plugins.
+ (go)       --no-scripts             Skips the execution of all scripts defined in composer.json file.
+ (go)   -d, --working-dir=WORKING-DIR If specified, use the given directory as working directory.
+ (go)       --no-cache               Prevent use of the cache

- (oracle)   Additionally it lets you edit most properties in the local composer.json.
- (oracle)   
- (oracle)   To set a config setting:

- (oracle)   
- (oracle)   To read a config setting:

- (oracle)

- (oracle)

- (oracle)

- (oracle)

- (oracle)   
- (oracle)   To remove a repository (repo is a short alias for repositories):

- (oracle)

- (oracle)   --global option.
- (oracle)

- (oracle)

- (oracle)

- (oracle)
